title: Minimise the Maximum Load
body:
Amazon distributes parcels among delivery agents. Initially the i-th of n agents is assigned parcels[i] parcels, and there are extra_parcels more that must all be assigned. Distribute the extra parcels so that the maximum number of parcels assigned to any one agent is as small as possible, and find that minimum possible maximum.

Function to complete

Complete getMinMaxParcels(parcels, extraParcels). It returns the minimum possible value of the maximum load.

  • parcels: the initial parcels per agent
  • extraParcels: the extra parcels to assign

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.
inp: The first line is n. Each of the next n lines is one parcels[i]. The final line is extra_parcels.
out: The value your function returns (the driver prints it): the minimum possible value of the maximum load on any agent.

samples.ex: Give 2 extra to the first agent and 1 to the second: loads become 3, 3, 3. The maximum is 3.
With one agent, all 3 extra parcels go to it, so it delivers 1 + 3 = 4.
